The dose described in this report is very high, potentially beyond Erowid's 'heavy' range, and could pose serious health risks or result in unwanted, extreme effects. Sometimes extremely high doses reported are errors rather than actual doses used.]
This experience was something I will never understand, it was mindblasting. Previously I had experienced with mushrooms, LSD, 2ce, mescaline and DOC
First I dosed 120mg insufflated. It hits the peak in about 1 hour by snorting it, so that was the moment I boosted it with 50 more mg. I was laying in my bed listening to music waiting for the redose to kick in. The visuals I experienced were so complicated, geometrical and non geometrical patterns in every possible colour. The music was morphing the beautifull visuals into new patterns. When I tried to completely relax, shut my mind and body off, they both floated away into the experience. I didnt feel myself.
I didnt feel myself.
I was in a void filled with visual eyecandy and the music felt like it was playing in the place I was, that felt incredible combined with the intense rushes of euphoria 2cb produces.
Then I tried something different. I left my earpods in but shut the music, I covered my eyes and laid down in the most comfortable position possible. This was really interesting, at these doses 2cb produces really cool cosmical/mysterious noises.
My brain was completely broken. For example, I was thinking about a spoon and a candle and it all made complete sense in my head but in a moment I realized WHAT the heck, that didnt make any sense at all? :D
It's been 3 days since this experience and I'm still having minor visuals, they are probably comparable to a 10mg trip. So taking this substance in excess definitely put so much strain on my brain that it could take days before the vision goes to normal.
2cb is a beautifull chemical. Sadly I overused it by doing 0.5 grams in 3 weeks, so I will not be coming back to this thing, I experienced many magical things, I'm very happy
<3
